name: url-chat
description: URL-CHAT: RAG-powered chat over any webpage, using LangChain.js, Google Gemini, and MongoDB Atlas.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm run start:prod --prefix server
